label: Line Chart
description: Canonical line-chart data-viz primitive: multi-series, full axis/line/point control, transparent/solid/image backgrounds.

values.label: Values
values.description: Numeric data — one series (number[]) or many (number[][]).

domain.label: Domain
domain.description: X/Y axis domain overrides + explicit numeric x values.

line.lineColor.label: Line Color
line.lineColor.description: Line color — single or per-series array.

line.strokeWidth.label: Stroke Width
line.strokeWidth.description: Stroke width — single or per-series array.

line.area.color.label: Color
line.area.color.description: Colour of the shaded area under the line; empty uses the line's own colour.

line.area.opacity.label: Opacity
line.area.opacity.description: How strong the shaded area under the line is, from invisible (0) to solid (1).

line.label: Line
line.description: Line stroke (single or per-series) + area fill.

points.pointBorder.color.label: Color
points.pointBorder.color.description: Colour of the ring drawn around each data point; empty draws no ring.

points.pointBorder.width.label: Width (px)
points.pointBorder.width.description: Thickness of the ring around each data point, in pixels; 0 draws none.

axes.xAxis.color.label: Axis color
axes.xAxis.color.description: Colour of the horizontal axis line along the bottom of the plot.

axes.xAxis.labelColor.label: Label color
axes.xAxis.labelColor.description: Colour of the category labels under the plot.

axes.xAxis.fontSize.label: Label size (px)
axes.xAxis.fontSize.description: Size of the category labels under the plot, in pixels.

axes.xAxis.tickLength.label: Tick length (px)
axes.xAxis.tickLength.description: Length of the small tick marks on the horizontal axis, in pixels.

axes.xAxis.tickColor.label: Tick color
axes.xAxis.tickColor.description: Colour of the tick marks on the horizontal axis.

axes.xAxis.gridOpacity.label: Grid opacity
axes.xAxis.gridOpacity.description: How strong the vertical gridlines are, from invisible (0) to solid (1).

axes.yAxis.color.label: Axis color
axes.yAxis.color.description: Colour of the vertical axis line along the left of the plot.

axes.yAxis.labelColor.label: Label color
axes.yAxis.labelColor.description: Colour of the value labels beside the plot.

axes.yAxis.fontSize.label: Label size (px)
axes.yAxis.fontSize.description: Size of the value labels beside the plot, in pixels.

axes.yAxis.decimals.label: Decimals
axes.yAxis.decimals.description: How many decimal places the value labels show.

axes.yAxis.prefix.label: Prefix
axes.yAxis.prefix.description: Text put before every value label (a currency sign, for one).

axes.yAxis.suffix.label: Suffix
axes.yAxis.suffix.description: Text put after every value label (a unit or a percent sign).

axes.yAxis.tickCount.label: Tick count
axes.yAxis.tickCount.description: How many value labels (and gridlines) the axis shows; empty picks a round number.

axes.yAxis.tickLength.label: Tick length (px)
axes.yAxis.tickLength.description: Length of the small tick marks on the vertical axis, in pixels.

axes.yAxis.tickColor.label: Tick color
axes.yAxis.tickColor.description: Colour of the tick marks on the vertical axis.

axes.yAxis.gridOpacity.label: Grid opacity
axes.yAxis.gridOpacity.description: How strong the horizontal gridlines are, from invisible (0) to solid (1).

axes.label: Axes
axes.description: X + Y axis lines, labels, grid, ticks.

appearance.preset.label: Preset
appearance.preset.description: Built-in color scheme (card / line / axes / text).

appearance.backgroundColor.label: Background
appearance.backgroundColor.description: Solid background color, or "none" for transparent.

appearance.border.color.label: Color
appearance.border.color.description: Colour of the hairline border around the card.

appearance.border.alpha.label: Alpha
appearance.border.alpha.description: How strong the card's border is, from invisible (0) to solid (1).

legend.color.label: Color
legend.color.description: Colour of the series names in the legend.

legend.fontSize.label: Font size (px)
legend.fontSize.description: Size of the series names in the legend, in pixels.

valueLabels.decimals.label: Decimals
valueLabels.decimals.description: How many decimal places the labels above the points show.

valueLabels.color.label: Color
valueLabels.color.description: Colour of the labels above the points; empty uses each line's colour.

valueLabels.fontSize.label: Font size (px)
valueLabels.fontSize.description: Size of the labels above the points, in pixels.

debugLayout.label: Debug layout
debugLayout.description: Dev-only: draw the layout contract (title / labels / legend fit their cells) instead of the chart.

theme.slug.label: Producer slug
theme.slug.description: Producer template to seed tokens from when the namespace isn't already on ctx (e.g. "@m0saic/theming/v1").

theme.preset.label: Preset
theme.preset.description: Producer preset/variant to request (e.g. light | dark | high-contrast for @m0saic/theming/v1; producer-defined).

theme.namespace.label: Namespace
theme.namespace.description: Upstream alias to read tokens from. Default "theme".

theme.forceFetch.label: Force fetch
theme.forceFetch.description: Re-seed via the slug even if the namespace is already populated.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Opt into a theme source. Reads the resolved preset's tokens by default; set a producer slug + namespace to pull shared design tokens (self-seeds when nothing is upstream).
